notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Golem, and at least one additional artifact creature.
description:
Activate Legion Extruder by paying {2}, tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature you control.
When the artifact creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Legion Extruder.
Resolve the Legion Extruder ability, creating a 3/3 Golem artifact creature token.
When the Golem enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}{C}.
Repeat.
If you control at least two Golems when the combo starts, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
